text: Dependencies declared DESCRIPTION, — ggtree aplot particular — come Bioconductor may need installing hand: conda environment recommended managing several Bioconductor packages .
code: if (!require("devtools")) install.packages("devtools") devtools::install_github("ssobt/VariPath") if (!require("BiocManager")) install.packages("BiocManager") BiocManager::install("ggtree") install.packages(c("enrichR", "aplot"))

title: Getting started with VariPath
text: need Seurat object PCA already run (Seurat::RunPCA()), carries metadata column identifying cell’s perturbation.
code: library(Seurat) library(VariPath)  # `adata` here is a Seurat object with a 'miR.family' column in its metadata # giving the decoy / guide identity of each cell. head(adata@meta.data[["miR.family"]])

title: Getting started with VariPath
text: Arguments worth thinking : sc_varipath() returns list: Save result immediately. object expensive recompute, plotting functions can exhaust memory large datasets — losing fit OOM part-way plotting avoidable annoyance:
code: out <- sc_varipath(   seurat_obj          = adata,   perturbation_column = "miR.family",   enrichR_dbs         = "GO_Biological_Process_2021",   loading_cutoff      = 0.1,   FDR                 = 0.25 ) saveRDS(out, "varipath_out.rds")

title: Getting started with VariPath
text: Two views, selected plot_type:
code: # Which perturbations move which rotated components plot_sc_varipath(out, plot_type = "perturbation")  # Which pathways each rotated component corresponds to plot_sc_varipath(out, plot_type = "pathway")

title: sc_varipath() — sc_varipath
text: seurat_obj Seurat object containing single-cell RNA-seq data PCA already run. perturbation_column name metadata column Seurat object containing cell perturbation/guide information. enrichR_dbs character vector enrichR database names use pathway enrichment analysis. Default 'GO_Biological_Process_2021'. loading_cutoff numeric value indicating loading cutoff use selecting genes associated rotated component. Default 0.1. FDR numeric value indicating FDR threshold use selecting significant components based guide association p-values. Default 0.25. advised save output function RDS file using saveRDS() immediately running easy loading future sessions memory failure can occur running downstream plotting functions large datasets.
